messages.author: 22bb1304f0d93574
messages.subject: Cannot start Device PNG
parts:
Hi there,

when I start shiny-server and open one of the examples, "Hello Shiny" appears and a scroll-item. That's good.

Unfortunately, instead of the graph there is a red error message "cannot start Device PNG". It's in German, though. So might it come directly from my R version?

Before that I had the problem that X11 was missing. shiny-server told me on the same spot. I solved it by compiling R on my own and having X11 enabled.

But now that message was replaced by "Cannot start Device PNG"

Any ideas how to fix that?

Thank you!
Tobias

png('output.png')
plot(1:5, 1:5)
dev.off()

-Winston

Hi,

I am having the same issue.   I had a little trouble compiling R 2.15.3 on my own - could that be the cause of this?

sudo cd /usr/local
sudo mkdir R
sudo wget http://cran.r-project.org/bin/linux/ubuntu/precise/r-base_2.15.3.orig.tar.gz 
sudo tar zxvf r-base_2.15.3.orig.tar.gz
cd R-2.15.3/
sudo apt-get install tk-dev gcc gfortran texlive texlive-fonts-extra libreadline-dev xorg-dev libxml2-dev libcurl4-gnutls-dev
sudo ./configure
sudo make
sudo make check
sudo make install

Does anyone have a suggestion for how to fix this?

thanks,
bobby
